Day 7 of the giant Amazon Black Friday sale is now underway, and it’s time to take a look at some of the deals you score on accessories for your Apple gear. Amazon’s wild deal on AirPods Pro 3 is still flying at $100 off, but we are also tracking some brilliant prices on even more affordable add-on gear, from AirTag 2 at the $18 Prime shipped all-time low and the lowest price of the year on the iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C) at $49, right over to rare deals on Apple Magic Mouse from $59 and the official Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max at 25% off.

Those deals join some seriously notable third-party offers on the popular new Twelve South AirFly Drive Wireless CarPlay Adapter has dropped to the $32 Amazon all-time low, loads of the latest Anker chargers at the best prices ever, Beats cables, and some great Logitech offers for your at-home Mac workstation. Check it all out below.
